name: Select Technology Inc
old_description: We will serve you as a valuable link in your supply chain, offering worldwide access to OEM, CEM and distributor inventories.
about:
Select Technology Inc operates from Rowley, Massachusetts, as an independent stocking distributor of electronic components. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, but it positions itself as a long-term supply-chain partner for original equipment manufacturers, contract electronics manufacturers, and other distributors.

The firm maintains an on-site inventory of more than 10,000 line items in a warehouse that is fully ESD- and MSD-compliant per IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033A. Its service portfolio includes bill-of-materials analysis and cost-reduction consulting, microscopic incoming inspection, solderability testing, destructive physical analysis (de-lidding), X-ray inspection, device programming, tape-and-reeling, dry-pack and baking, and cross-referencing for obsolete or hard-to-find parts. Account managers average over ten years of industry experience, while the quality-control inspection team averages twenty years.

Select Technology serves direct manufacturers, franchise and independent distributors, and Fortune 500 OEMs and CEMs. Its supplier base includes components from Altera, Xilinx, Broadcom, Motorola, Freescale, Texas Instruments, PMC Sierra, Mindspeed, Globespan, and Intel. The company also offers excess-inventory buyouts, consignment programs, and a customer portal for real-time order and inventory visibility.

The company emphasizes speed, reliability, experience, and honesty as its differentiators, highlighting same-day shipping on stocked parts, a counterfeit-prevention process that includes microscopic inspection and third-party lab testing, and custom inventory-management solutions tailored to each partner’s supply-chain cycle.
